They built a $1.7 billion steel tomb to contain Chernobyl’s Reactor 4, but inside the New Safe Confinement, a terrifying transformation is happening. The infamous Elephant’s Foot is literally disintegrating from the inside out.

Instead of remaining a solid, dormant chunk of nuclear waste, this radioactive monster is decaying into far more dangerous than anyone ever expected.

Find out why the world’s largest moveable structure is suddenly facing a phantom threat it was never designed to handle, and what happens when a nuclear disaster enters an unpredictable new phase.
